sloka: सन्दश्य दशनैरोष्ठं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः।राक्षसैरपि दुर्दर्शः कालाग्निरिव मूर्च्छितः ।। ६.९६.३ ।।
transliteration: sandaśya daśanairoṣṭhaṁ krodhasaṁraktalocanaḥ।rākṣasairapi durdarśaḥ kālāgniriva mūrcchitaḥ ।। 6.96.3 ।।

translations.english: Biting his teeth, eyes turned red in wrath, Ravana was perplexed. He was difficult to look at even for the Rakshasas.
